items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 152:1
items.html: (To the question) From the Mochin of VAK of ZA and above, they already cause ascents to all the Partzufim of AK and ABYA. But the VAK themselves of ZA, which are the aspect of Nefesh-Ruach of the Ruach, are according to the fixed Mochin in Atzilut, which never change: where Atik is Keter, AA is Hochma, AVI and YESHSUT are Bina, and ZA is VAK — namely, according to the statures of the new MA. (Item 188).
